Hi Rebecca — thanks again for the demo today. Great to hear how Peak Insights plans to use streaming embeddings for analyst workflows. As promised, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures milestones, owners, and dependencies. High level: we mapped a target production date and the procurement/contract signoff gate.

Key items in this draft (see MAP_v1.xlsx):
- Target close (commercial signature): 2025-06-18 (proposed)
- Procurement PO expected by: 2025-06-20 (per your note on the call)
- Implementation milestone 1 (pilot data ingest): 2 weeks post-signature – owner: Peak Insights
- Redwood tasks: SOW finalization (legal), dedicated capacity sizing, SOC-2 evidence handoff

As next steps: can you confirm whether 6/20 is the firm PO cutoff for your internal quarter close? If yes, I'd like to flag 6/18 as the latest signature date so your procurement team has two business days to issue a PO and marshal budget. If procurement needs a longer runway we can shift the signature earlier; just tell me the hard PO date and we’ll align.

I copied Laura (CS lead) to weigh in on implementation sequencing and Ben (legal) will review commercial terms if we get a firm sign date.

Attachment: MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — Soojin

Thanks for the heads up, Soojin. Quick legal read below: 

1) SOW & attachments — I reviewed SOW_PeakInsights_v1.docx. Commercial terms look standard; no unusual indemnities or data-sharing asks in the draft. We do need to attach the DPA and the standard SOC-2 evidence package. I'll prepare the DPA template and insert references in the SOW by EOD Tuesday (5/13).

2) Timing — 6/18 signature is tight but workable. To hit that date we need Peak to accept our final SOW and pricing by EOD Friday 6/13 so we have a 3-business-day window for legal to finalize redlines and for internal sign-off. If Peak expects counsel-to-counsel redlines after 6/13 that could push signature beyond 6/18.

3) SLA exceptions — there's one ask to call out: Peak's usage profile mentions bursty streaming inference. We should preemptively offer a burst-scaling clause (no-cost 5% buffer for first 60 days) instead of opening a lengthy SLA exception conversation. I'll draft recommended language for that clause.

I can have the DPA + annotated SOW back by Tuesday EOD. If Soojin can confirm the proposal to Rebecca (deadline for their acceptance 6/13), I'll queue this for expedited review.

Ben
